summary: Verified all 6 iter-29 fixes on EMERGENT preview env. FIX1 scroll animation fully removed (no game-card-animate/game-card-hidden classes in DOM, computed animation-name='none' on cards, no inline animationDelay). FIX2 gold gradient ambient lighting restored — exactly 3 layers under .fixed.inset-0.-z-10, first child has gold-ambient-pulse class with radial-gradient rgba(255,215,0,0.45) and blur(70px); body background is rich royal purple linear-gradient(140deg, #1A0A2E -> #4A2766 -> #1A0A2E). FIX3 versionCheck.js correctly accepts {force:true} opts and bypasses the 60s localStorage throttle while still respecting the 30s RELOAD_FLAG loop guard. FIX4 AdminPage.js imports checkVersionAndMaybeReload and calls it with {force:true} in first useEffect after admin role check — E2E verified by intercepting /api/version with 2099.12.31.99 and confirming hard-reload to /admin?_v=2099.12.31.99. FIX6 /api/version returns 2026.02.24.5 matching APP_BUILD_VERSION constant. FIX5 regression confirmed: 2 play-btn-* (running games gold buttons), 4 timeout-btn-* (closed games red X), Telegram welcome popup with Download MATKA 11 App button renders on dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLoginPage emits a React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AdminLoginPage)' — indicates a setState/navigate() being called during render rather than inside a useEffect. Not blocking but should be wrapped in useEffect to silence the warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 29 verified all 3 user-reported fixes: scroll animation removed, gold gradient restored, admin force-version-check working. Backend /api/version returns 2026.02.24.5 matching frontend APP_BUILD_VERSION. Admin login redirects directly to /admin (not /dashboard) — keep this in mind. The browser computes rgba/hex differently than source code (rgba spaces normalized; hex converted to rgb) so be careful with string-match assertions on style values.
